basis: Structured delegation taxonomy inspired by GAIDeT (Generative AI Delegation Taxonomy, 2025) and the settled COPE/ICMJE disclosure principles. This config is a working template, not a copy of any publisher policy.

sources.name: COPE position statement — Authorship and AI tools
COPE forum coverage: from detection to disclosure (2025)
Wolters Kluwer generative AI policy for authors
CASRAI — Can AI be listed as an author?

settled_rules: An AI tool cannot be an author: it cannot take responsibility, hold copyright, declare conflicts of interest or approve the final manuscript.
All substantive AI use must be disclosed, naming the tool and version and describing what it was used for, usually in Methods and/or Acknowledgements and in the cover letter.
Human authors remain fully responsible for every factual claim, citation, figure and the decision to submit.
Spelling/grammar-only assistance is often exempt from disclosure, but policies differ: check the target venue.
Editors and reviewers must not upload confidential manuscripts into AI systems that train on inputs.
Policies change: re-read the official author guidelines on submission day.

delegation_categories.label: Research question, hypotheses, study design
delegation_categories.typical_tasks: brainstorming questions, rival explanations, falsification tests
delegation_categories.human_check: A named author decides the final question and design; AI suggestions are not evidence.

delegation_categories.label: Literature search and query building
delegation_categories.typical_tasks: synonym expansion, query translation across databases
delegation_categories.human_check: Log every final query with date, database, filters and hits (PRISMA-S).

delegation_categories.label: Title/abstract and full-text screening
delegation_categories.human_check: Dual human decisions and adjudication remain mandatory; report kappa.

delegation_categories.label: Data extraction and coding
delegation_categories.human_check: Verify every extracted value against the source text and keep a quote/locator.

delegation_categories.label: Statistical analysis and code
delegation_categories.typical_tasks: generating analysis scripts, debugging, explaining output
delegation_categories.human_check: Re-run the analysis from raw data; archive code, environment and seeds.

delegation_categories.label: Drafting manuscript text
delegation_categories.typical_tasks: first drafts of sections, restructuring arguments
delegation_categories.human_check: Rewrite in the authors' voice and verify each assertion against the evidence ledger.

delegation_categories.label: Language editing and formatting
delegation_categories.human_check: Confirm no meaning changed; many venues exempt grammar-only help.

delegation_categories.label: Translation
delegation_categories.human_check: Back-translation or bilingual review; disclose if required by the venue.

delegation_categories.label: Figures, tables and graphical abstracts
delegation_categories.human_check: Never generate or alter original research images; check every number against the data.

prohibited_claims: AI can be listed as a co-author
A grammar checker proves the manuscript is original
